usage.general: Use one MDI set only when the icon distinguishes an actor, trust boundary or object type. Labels remain visible.
usage.platform: Use the original platform logo only when the diagram explicitly names that product. AWS services use official AWS architecture icons.
usage.omit: Omit decoration for named business actions, generic databases or queues already identified by their shape, and structural fields such as JWT parts.
usage.extension: Add vendor source, original/result hashes and rights notice to this shared catalog before use; never copy icons into a consumer.
usage.controls: Use the existing shared controls and components unchanged. Diagram icon selection never overrides the common toolbar.
